scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run rebuild:electron && playwright test
scripts.build: npm run build -w @archivist/renderer && npm run build -w @archivist/desktop
scripts.dev: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run dev -w @archivist/desktop
scripts.start: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run start -w @archivist/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @archivist/desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run dist:win -w @archivist/desktop
